Title: Add a new expense transaction manually
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app with no existing transactions
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Groceries' as the title. 4. Enter '500' as the amount. 5. Select 'Shopping' as the category. 6. Select 'Cash' as the source. 7. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Groceries, Amount: 500, Category: Shopping, Source: Cash
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list on the home screen. The balance updates to reflect a new expense of 500 in the selected currency. The transaction shows 'Groceries', '500', 'Shopping', and 'Cash' as the source.

Title: Add a new income transaction manually
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app with no existing transactions
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Income' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Salary' as the title. 4. Enter '30000' as the amount. 5. Select 'Salary' as the category. 6. Select 'Bank' as the source. 7. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Salary, Amount: 30000, Category: Salary, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list on the home screen. The balance updates to reflect a new income of 30000 in the selected currency. The transaction shows 'Salary', '30000', 'Salary', and 'Bank' as the source.

Title: Edit an existing transaction
Preconditions: User has at least one transaction recorded (e.g., an expense of 500 for Groceries)
Steps:
1. Tap on the existing transaction in the list to open the edit sheet. 2. Change the amount from '500' to '600'. 3. Change the category from 'Shopping' to 'Food'. 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Updated Amount: 600, Updated Category: Food
Expected Result: The transaction is updated in the list. The balance reflects the updated amount of 600. The transaction details now show '600' and 'Food' as the category.

Title: Change the app currency from default to another currency
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app
Steps:
1. Tap the settings icon in the bottom navigation bar. 2. Tap on 'Currency' under the App Settings section. 3. Select 'USD - US Dollar' from the list. 4. Return to the home screen.

Test Data: Currency: USD - US Dollar
Expected Result: The app currency updates to USD. All transaction amounts and balance totals on the home screen are displayed in USD with the '$' symbol.

Title: Add a transaction with a future date
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Rent' as the title. 4. Enter '10000' as the amount. 5. Select 'Rent' as the category. 6. Select 'Bank' as the source. 7. Tap the date field and select a date 5 days in the future. 8. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Rent, Amount: 10000, Category: Rent, Source: Bank, Date: Future date (5 days ahead)
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list sorted by date. The future-dated transaction appears at the top of the list if no other future transactions exist.

Title: Generate a transaction report with income and expense transactions
Preconditions: User has at least one income and one expense transaction recorded
Steps:
1. Add an income transaction of 1000. 2. Add an expense transaction of 500. 3. Open the transaction report generation feature.

Test Data: Income transaction amount: 1000, Expense transaction amount: 500
Expected Result: A transaction report is generated with the total income and total expense amounts displayed correctly

Title: Generate a transaction report with multiple income and expense transactions
Preconditions: User has multiple income and expense transactions recorded
Steps:
1. Add multiple income transactions with different amounts. 2. Add multiple expense transactions with different amounts. 3. Open the transaction report generation feature.

Test Data: Multiple income transactions with amounts: 1000, 2000, 3000. Multiple expense transactions with amounts: 500, 1000, 1500
Expected Result: A transaction report is generated with the total income and total expense amounts displayed correctly

Title: Generate a transaction report with no transactions
Preconditions: User has no transactions recorded
Steps:
1. Open the transaction report generation feature with no transactions recorded.

Test Data: No transactions recorded
Expected Result: A transaction report is generated with zero total income and zero total expense amounts displayed

Title: Verify new permissions do not cause issues with app functionality
Preconditions: The app is installed on an Android device with the updated AndroidManifest.xml
Steps:
1. Deploy the app with the updated AndroidManifest.xml. 2. Run the app and perform actions that require the new permissions (MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE). 3. Observe if the app behaves as expected and if any permission-related errors occur.

Test Data: New permissions: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (maxSdkVersion=28)
Expected Result: The app should function correctly and not crash due to permission issues. The app should be able to manage external storage and write to external storage on devices with SDK version 28 or lower.

Title: Attempt to record an expense with no source selected

1. Enter a valid amount (e.g., 500). 2. Leave the 'Source' field unselected. 3. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 500, Type: Expense, Source: (none selected)
Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Source is required' and does not save the transaction. The 'Save' button remains disabled until a source is selected.

Preconditions: User is logged in and on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:

Expected Result: The system displays an error message 'Amount must be positive' and does not save the transaction. The amount field is highlighted in red.

Title: Attempt to record an expense exceeding the available balance in the selected source
Preconditions: User has a bank balance of 1000 and is on the 'Add Transaction' screen
Steps:
1. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 2. Enter an amount (e.g., 1500) greater than the available bank balance. 3. Select 'Bank' as the source. 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Amount: 1500, Type: Expense, Source: Bank, Available Balance: 1000
Expected Result: The system displays an amber warning banner 'This transaction exceeds your available balance. Record as Credit/Loan?' and changes the call-to-action button to 'Record as Credit/Loan'. The transaction is not saved as a regular expense.

Test Data: Amount: 1500, Type: Withdrawal, Available Balance: 1000
